name: Haskell (ghcup)
postCreateCommand: set -eux; curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://get-ghcup.haskell.org | sh -s -- -y; export PATH=$HOME/.ghcup/bin:$PATH; ~/.ghcup/bin/ghcup install ghc || true; ~/.ghcup/bin/ghcup install cabal || true; ~/.ghcup/bin/ghcup install hls || true; ~/.ghcup/bin/ghcup install cabal-install || true; cabal --version || true
